title: parse_args: while let + args.next() should use for arg in &mut args
description: smtp/main.rs, imap/main.rs, and mail/main.rs all use 'while let Some(arg) = args.next()' to iterate args. clippy::while_let_on_iterator flags this. The idiomatic form is 'for arg in args.by_ref()' (or 'for arg in &mut args'), which lets the loop body still call args.next() to consume the value argument after --config. The while let form works but misleads readers into thinking this is not a standard iteration.
